name: Marketing Working Session
detail: A focused 45-minute session about one marketing question. Includes light preparation using up to two supplied items, a concise written action list and one clarification email within seven days. Full audits, plans and implementation are separate.

name: Website Review & Updates
detail: Review of up to five existing pages, up to ten prioritized recommendations and up to five agreed small updates within two hours of implementation. Includes a 30-minute intake, 45-minute walkthrough and one clarification round. Updates such as copy, images, links or calls to action are agreed after checking platform access. Redesign, custom development and technical SEO are separate.

name: Social Action Plan
detail: For businesses handling their own publishing: one goal and audience, one channel or coordinated Instagram/Facebook, a four-week calendar with up to eight content ideas, a 30-minute handoff and one revision. Finished content and publishing are separate. Choose this or the multi-channel plan; ongoing social support already includes monthly planning.

name: Multi-channel Action Plan
detail: One goal across up to two channels, including email where appropriate. Includes a brief scan of two competitors, a four-week calendar with up to eight total content/campaign ideas, priorities, responsibilities, simple measures, kickoff/handoff and one revision. Email production, sending, automations and setup are separate. Monthly advisory already includes a concise monthly action list.

name: Website Refresh Plan
detail: Planning starts at $700 for up to five existing pages. A coordinated review of content, structure, layout, navigation and calls to action; a page-by-page change brief with suggested structure and agreed examples; one review and one revision. Implementation is confirmed and priced in your proposal. Full copywriting, design files, wireframes, technical specifications, new builds and complex integrations require separate scope. Reuse prior review findings to avoid duplicate assessment charges.

name: Monthly Social Media Support
detail: Eight unique feed posts and captions, including up to two simple carousels of up to three slides each. Uses supplied assets and existing templates; each carousel counts as one post. Includes monthly social priorities/content calendar, one channel or coordinated Instagram/Facebook using the same eight posts, scheduling after approval, one revision batch, basic reporting and a 20-minute check-in. Confirm usable assets before booking and agree materials/approval deadlines; late inputs can move the schedule. Shoots, video, daily DMs/comments and ads are separate. Paid one-month pilot; $150 setup only if needed and agreed.

name: Monthly Marketing Advisory
detail: Two 45-minute calls, feedback on up to two supplied items (one page or campaign brief each), and existing metrics from up to two channels. Includes a concise monthly action list for one goal and up to two channels, responsibilities and simple measures, plus 30 minutes of between-call email support. Builds on existing strategy rather than creating a new strategy document monthly. Replies within two business days. Production, publishing, email execution, automations and technical work are separate. Unused scope does not roll over.

name: Website Content Update Support
detail: One monthly batch with up to 90 minutes of agreed copy, image or promotion updates on a supported existing website, plus checking and a completion note. Platform access confirmed before booking. No rollover. Hosting, security/plugin maintenance, emergencies, development, new pages and redesign are separate.

name: Google Business Profile Tune-Up
detail: One existing, verified profile: review and agreed business details, categories, services and supplied photo updates; check website contact details match; short priorities checklist and one clarification email. Website edits, verification issues, suspension recovery, ongoing posting, keyword research and broader SEO are separate.

name: Four additional static posts
detail: Add-on to social support: supplied assets and existing templates, same campaign approach, captions, scheduling and one consolidated revision. Four additional single-image posts; new strategy and custom production are separate.

name: Four simple story sets
detail: Add-on to social support: up to three frames per set, repurposed from approved content using supplied assets and existing templates, one revision. No original video editing. Specify the delivery month in the proposal.

name: Simple newsletter or promotion
detail: $150 per email for existing clients. Adapt approved content and supplied images, up to 400 words, using an existing account/template and subscriber audience. Subject line, preview text, one revision, link/rendering checks and a test, then one scheduled send to one approved audience after client approval. Original copy/new layouts, custom HTML, account setup, list imports/cleanup, automations, segmentation, resends and platform fees are separate. This selection is one email, not recurring monthly email service.
